description_excerpt: Job Description Role purpose The Country Safety Manager leads the design and execution of safety priorities in Vietnam. The role identifies and reduces safety risks affecting passengers, driver- and delivery-partners, merchants, and other road users. Working with country and regional teams, the manager turns safety insights into practical programs, strengthens incident response, and builds effective partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
